verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party docs describe Handoff: when a Mac and iPhone or iPad are near each other, they automatically pass what you're doing between devices, and you can pick up right where you left off (docs-4, docs-39). They also give concrete cross-device continuation examples, such as dragging a video to iPhone to keep editing and resuming a Siri conversation started on iPhone (docs-43, docs-52). missing for 10: in-depth documentation of supported apps, pairing requirements and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that handoff works reliably.
